U.S. President Donald Trump has predicted a “very big” deal with Russia that could extend beyond the Ukraine war to involve all of Europe. His remarks came after a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin’s envoy at the White House on November 5, 2026.
The comments have raised concerns among European allies that Washington could move closer to Moscow and pressure Ukraine into accepting an unfavourable peace deal. Meanwhile, First Lady Melania Trump has called for a more lasting ceasefire in Ukraine.
Thank you for watching our video!
